correctness.rationale: Auditor independently re-ran inputs/artifacts/build.py, disprove.py, verify.py (stdlib only, seconds): HX/HZ 105x238, all row weights 8 (w0=8), HX*HZ^T=0 with 0 violations, rank(HX)=rank(HZ)=97 so k=44, N=238. Full 2^16 kernel census of B (rank 19, dimker 16) gives exact d(B)=6 with distribution {6:21,8:98,10:658,...} matching DRAFT. All 105 wt-6 and 490 wt-8 lifts [e_j tensor c;0] verified HZ-syndrome 0 and remainder nonzero mod rowspace(HX). Explicit witness l support {0,4,10,18,21,24} (classical (var,shift) {(0,0),(0,4),(1,3),(2,4),(3,0),(3,3)} at block j=0) verified HZ*l=0 and rank(HX+l)=98, hence non-trivial X-logical weight 6, so d(Q*)<=6 falsifies d>=9. Auditor cross-checked with an independent bytearray Gauss-Jordan implementation (different code path): same ranks 97/97, orth 0, d(B)=6 count 21. Expansion: exhaustive 59535 subsets sizes 1-4 gives 0 failures for |S|<=3 and 84 failures at |S|=4; auditor spot-checked e.g. {0,1,21,29} -> |N|=7<8 by hand from E. Claim is exact F2 proof by exhaustive enumeration, not heuristic; limitations (exact d possibly <6, index-map permutations) honestly stated.
